kjv: whose goings forth [have been] from of old, from everlasting (KJV 5:2)
mine: Whose origins are from of old, from ancient days
note: mime olam means "from days of antiquity" (as in 7:14 "as in the days of old"), pointing to the ancient Davidic line from Bethlehem; KJV's "from everlasting" suggests the eternal pre-existence of the ruler, the classic messianic reading.
